title: Vieta-Type Formulas for Matrix Polynomials
summary: The classical Vieta formulas relate the coefficients of a complex scalar polynomial to the elementary symmetric polynomials of its roots. In this paper, we establish analogous spectral identities for complex matrix polynomials. For a monic matrix polynomial, we prove that the sum of all its eigenvalues equals the sum of the roots of the product of its diagonal scalar polynomials and is also equal to a constant multiple of the sum of the roots of the scalar polynomial obtained by summing its diagonal entries.
